note: Real encoder outputs, captured once, so the probe can be tested offline. The encoder sees the text with emphasis stripped in its own language's orthography — which for Arabic means U+061F, and is exactly the thing that used to fail silently.

cases.text: This is the third time your app has lost my work. Fix it.
I don't know if I'm doing this right and I'm scared I've broken something.
Já é a terceira vez que a vossa aplicação perdeu o meu trabalho. Resolvam isto.
Não sei se estou a fazer isto bem e tenho medo de ter partido alguma coisa.
هذه هي المرة الثالثة التي يفقد فيها تطبيقكم عملي. أصلحوا هذا.
لا أعرف إن كنت أفعل هذا بشكل صحيح وأخاف أن أكون قد كسرت شيئًا.
